categories.title: Aggregators & Vertical Media
categories.description: LLM-citable, structured surfaces that aggregate Korean crypto narratives.
categories.description_ko: 한국 암호화폐 내러티브를 구조화해 LLM이 인용할 수 있게 만든 서비스.

categories.title: Signal Pipelines & Datasets
categories.description: Tools that ingest Korean creators / news / macro feeds and emit structured canonical data.
categories.description_ko: 한국 크리에이터·뉴스·매크로 피드를 받아 정규화된 데이터로 내보내는 도구.

categories.title: MCP Servers (Korean Market)
categories.description: Model Context Protocol servers exposing Korean-market data to MCP clients (Claude, Cursor, Cline, …).
categories.description_ko: 한국 시장 데이터를 MCP 클라이언트(Claude, Cursor, Cline 등)에 노출하는 Model Context Protocol 서버.

categories.title: Exchange APIs
categories.description: Official REST/WebSocket APIs from Korean crypto exchanges. Their public market-data endpoints are auth-free (R0), but the same credentialed API also places orders and moves funds — so each entry is rated at its full capability (R3). Use the auth-free subset for data; scope your API keys carefully.
categories.description_ko: 한국 암호화폐 거래소의 공식 REST/WebSocket API. 공개 시세 엔드포인트는 인증 불필요(R0)지만, 동일 API의 인증 엔드포인트가 주문·출금까지 수행하므로 각 항목은 최대 권한(R3) 기준으로 표기한다. 데이터는 인증 불필요 엔드포인트를 쓰고, API 키 권한은 신중히 설정할 것.

categories.title: Exchange Trading Agents & Skills
categories.description: Agent-facing kits (MCP / Skills / CLI) published by or for Korean exchanges. Many can place orders or move funds — read the risk class and required permissions before wiring one to a live key.
categories.description_ko: 한국 거래소가 배포하거나 거래소를 위해 만든 에이전트용 키트(MCP/Skills/CLI). 상당수가 주문·출금까지 수행할 수 있으므로, 실거래 키에 연결하기 전에 위험 등급과 필요한 권한을 반드시 확인할 것.

categories.title: Macro & Market Data APIs
categories.description: Official / freemium APIs for Korean macro indicators and market statistics.
categories.description_ko: 한국 매크로 지표·시장 통계를 위한 공식/프리미엄 API.

categories.title: Regulatory & Compliance Data
categories.description: Official grounding data on registered operators and market structure — useful for compliance-aware agents.
categories.description_ko: 신고 사업자·시장 구조에 관한 공식 근거 데이터. 컴플라이언스를 고려하는 에이전트에 유용.

categories.title: On-Chain & Wallet Tooling
categories.description: Korean-market-relevant on-chain infrastructure and agent tooling.
categories.description_ko: 한국 시장과 관련된 온체인 인프라 및 에이전트 도구.

categories.title: Maintainer-Affiliated Resources & Disclosures
categories.description: Resources published by the maintainers of this catalog (the Mossland ecosystem), collected here for full disclosure. They are listed for transparency, not as neutral recommendations.
categories.description_ko: 이 카탈로그의 메인테이너(Mossland 생태계)가 발행한 리소스를 이해관계 공개 차원에서 모았다. 중립적 추천이 아니라 투명성을 위해 나열한다.

resources.name: Alpha by Mossland
resources.description: Korean crypto × AI vertical-media surface — channel-level stance distribution, AI-synthesized daily briefs, retrievable RAG Q&A, and a directory of disclosed AI personas, built on Korean YouTube + news + macro feeds.
resources.description_ko: 한국 암호화폐 × AI 버티컬 미디어 — 채널별 스탠스 분포, AI 데일리 브리핑, RAG Q&A, 공개된 AI 페르소나 디렉터리. 한국 유튜브·뉴스·매크로 피드 기반.
resources.korea_relevance: Aggregates Korean-language crypto/macro narratives (YouTube, news, KR macro) into an LLM-citable surface.
resources.ai_utility: RAG Q&A plus a structured entity/topic/event store agents can query; paired with an MCP server (see alpha-mcp).
resources.status_reason: Live beta — the homepage entity/topic/event counters render 0 while the /ask backend reports populated data, and the AI-personas feature self-declares pre-launch ('Phase 1.2, catalog-only'). Verify current state before citing figures.
resources.status_reason_ko: 라이브 베타 — 홈페이지의 엔티티/토픽/이벤트 카운터는 0으로 표시되지만 /ask 백엔드에는 데이터가 채워져 있고, AI 페르소나 기능은 사전 출시('Phase 1.2, 카탈로그만')를 스스로 명시. 수치를 인용하기 전 현재 상태 확인 필요.

resources.name: Moss Coin (MOC) ERC-20 Contract
resources.description: Mossland's own Moss Coin (MOC) ERC-20 (2025) token contract — a standard OpenZeppelin ERC-20 with Burnable, Permit (EIP-2612), and Votes (ERC20Votes), fixed 500M supply, deployed ownerless to Ethereum mainnet. Audited by CertiK (Skynet), Aug 2025.
resources.description_ko: Mossland 자체 Moss Coin(MOC) ERC-20(2025) 토큰 컨트랙트 — OpenZeppelin 표준 ERC-20(Burnable, Permit(EIP-2612), Votes(ERC20Votes)), 5억 고정 발행, 소유자 없이 이더리움 메인넷 배포. CertiK(Skynet) 감사(2025-08).
resources.korea_relevance: The token contract of a Korean crypto/AI project (this catalog's maintainer).
resources.ai_utility: Reference ERC-20 with governance/permit extensions.
resources.status_reason: Not general-purpose 'on-chain tooling' — it is Mossland's single-project token contract. The CertiK audit is linked (not hosted in-repo) and reported one centralization finding marked 'Partially Resolved'.
resources.status_reason_ko: 범용 '온체인 도구'가 아니라 Mossland 단일 프로젝트의 토큰 컨트랙트. CertiK 감사는 링크만 제공(리포에 미포함)되며 '부분 해결(Partially Resolved)'로 표시된 중앙화 관련 지적 1건 존재.

resources.name: Mossland Disclosures
resources.description: Mossland project disclosure dashboard — MOC token supply schedule, circulating supply, on-chain/DAO activity, and a materials log (client-rendered SPA pulling live market data).
resources.description_ko: Mossland 프로젝트 공시 대시보드 — MOC 토큰 공급 스케줄, 유통량, 온체인/DAO 활동, 자료 로그(라이브 시장 데이터를 불러오는 SPA).
resources.korea_relevance: Transparency data for a Korean crypto/AI project.
resources.ai_utility: Structured disclosure data (served via its /api/disclosure endpoint).

resources.name: Mossland Projects Timeline
resources.description: Index of projects Mossland has developed since 2018, with current service status.
resources.description_ko: 2018년부터 Mossland이 개발한 프로젝트 목록과 현재 서비스 상태.
resources.korea_relevance: History of a Korean crypto/AI project.
resources.ai_utility: Project inventory / status reference.

resources.name: Mossland Whitepaper v3.1
resources.description: Mossland project whitepaper (v3.1), bilingual EN/KO.
resources.description_ko: Mossland 프로젝트 백서(v3.1), 영/한 이중언어.
resources.korea_relevance: Documentation for a Korean crypto/AI project.
resources.ai_utility: Background/context document (PDF).

resources.name: Bithumb API
resources.description: Official API for Bithumb, a major Korean KRW exchange. Public API (ticker, orderbook, candles) needs no auth; private API (JWT) adds balances, orders, and withdrawal. Ships an llms.txt for agent tooling.
resources.description_ko: 주요 KRW 거래소 빗썸의 공식 API. 공개 API(시세·오더북·캔들)는 인증 불필요, 프라이빗 API(JWT)는 잔고·주문·출금 제공. 에이전트용 llms.txt 제공.
resources.korea_relevance: Second-largest KRW exchange; core Korean market data.
resources.ai_utility: Auth-free public endpoints plus an llms.txt; private endpoints reach R3 once keyed.

resources.name: Coinone API
resources.description: Official API for Coinone, a Korean KRW exchange (~10% domestic share). Public ticker/orderbook endpoints need no auth; private endpoints add balances, orders, and withdrawal. Ships an llms.txt.
resources.description_ko: KRW 거래소 코인원(국내 점유율 약 10%)의 공식 API. 공개 시세·오더북 엔드포인트는 인증 불필요, 프라이빗 엔드포인트는 잔고·주문·출금 제공. llms.txt 제공.
resources.korea_relevance: Third major KRW exchange; complements Upbit/Bithumb market data.
resources.ai_utility: Auth-free public endpoints plus an llms.txt; private endpoints reach R3 once keyed.

resources.name: GOPAX API
resources.description: Official REST API for GOPAX, a Korean KRW exchange. Public endpoints are usable without authentication; private (keyed) endpoints add account, trading, and withdrawal. Docs maintained since 2017.
resources.description_ko: KRW 거래소 고팍스의 공식 REST API. 공개 엔드포인트는 인증 없이 사용 가능, 프라이빗(키) 엔드포인트는 계정·거래·출금 제공. 2017년부터 유지되는 문서.
resources.korea_relevance: Additional KRW exchange market data.
resources.ai_utility: Auth-free public endpoints; private endpoints reach R3 once keyed.

resources.name: Korbit Open API
resources.description: Official API (v2) for Korbit, Korea's oldest crypto exchange. REST + WebSocket, public quotation endpoints plus private account/order/deposit/withdrawal. Notably AI-agent-oriented — ships an llms.txt / llms-full.txt, an MCP server, and an official Go CLI (korbit-cli).
resources.description_ko: 국내 최초 거래소 코빗의 공식 API(v2). REST + 웹소켓, 공개 시세 및 프라이빗 계정·주문·입출금. AI 에이전트 지향 — llms.txt / llms-full.txt, MCP 서버, 공식 Go CLI(korbit-cli) 제공.
resources.korea_relevance: KRW market-data and trading API from a long-standing Korean exchange, filling a gap in the previous list.
resources.ai_utility: Purpose-built for agents (llms.txt, MCP, CLI). Public endpoints R0; private endpoints span R1–R3 (HMAC-SHA256 or Ed25519 keys) and include withdrawal.
resources.status_reason: GitHub org korbit-official is GitHub-verified but new (created 2026-06); the CLI/MCP tooling is freshly launched rather than battle-tested.
resources.status_reason_ko: GitHub 조직 korbit-official은 GitHub 인증되었으나 신규(2026-06 생성); CLI/MCP 도구는 검증된 것이 아니라 갓 출시됨.

resources.name: Upbit Open API
resources.description: Official API for Upbit, Korea's largest crypto exchange by domestic volume (~72% share). KRW-pair ticker, candles, orderbook, and WebSocket. Public market-data endpoints need no auth; authenticated endpoints add balances, order placement, and withdrawal.
resources.description_ko: 국내 거래대금 1위(약 72%) 거래소 업비트의 공식 API. KRW 페어 시세·캔들·오더북·웹소켓. 공개 시세 엔드포인트는 인증 불필요, 인증 엔드포인트는 잔고·주문·출금까지 제공.
resources.korea_relevance: Primary KRW market-data and trading API for the dominant Korean exchange.
resources.ai_utility: Auth-free public endpoints are ideal LLM/agent data sources; note private endpoints reach R3 (withdrawal) once keyed.

resources.name: BOK ECOS
resources.description: Bank of Korea Economic Statistics System open API — base rate, government-bond yields, USD/KRW, CPI, M2, national accounts, balance of payments (834 tables, 100+ key indicators). Free auth key (auto-issued on signup); a 'sample' key works for testing.
resources.description_ko: 한국은행 경제통계시스템(ECOS) 공개 API — 기준금리, 국고채 금리, 원/달러, CPI, M2, 국민계정, 국제수지(834개 통계표, 100+ 주요지표). 가입 시 자동 발급되는 무료 인증키(테스트는 'sample' 키).
resources.korea_relevance: Authoritative Korean macro/monetary time series — the macro backbone for KOSPI↔BTC and kimchi-premium context.
resources.ai_utility: Clean REST/JSON for grounding agents in current KR macro (verified serving today's data).

resources.name: FRED — Korea, Republic of (South Korea)
resources.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
resources.description: St. Louis Fed's FRED category for South Korea (category 32286) — mirrored Korean macro series (rates, FX, prices, national accounts). Free API key. (The previous list linked 32263, which is the 'International Data' parent category, not Korea.)
resources.description_ko: 세인트루이스 연은 FRED의 대한민국 카테고리(32286) — 한국 매크로 시계열(금리·환율·물가·국민계정) 미러. 무료 API 키. (기존 목록의 32263은 한국이 아니라 'International Data' 상위 카테고리였음.)
resources.korea_relevance: English-labeled Korean macro series, convenient for cross-country agents.
resources.ai_utility: Well-documented REST API with stable series IDs.

resources.name: KOSIS Open API
resources.description: Korea's national statistics portal (KOSIS) open API — demographics, prices, employment, industrial production. Now operated by the National Data Administration (국가데이터처), which replaced Statistics Korea (통계청) on 2025-10-01. Requires SSO login and a free key.
resources.description_ko: 국가통계포털(KOSIS) 공개 API — 인구·물가·고용·산업생산. 2025-10-01 통계청을 대체한 국가데이터처가 운영. SSO 로그인과 무료 인증키 필요.
resources.korea_relevance: Official Korean socio-economic statistics.
resources.ai_utility: Structured statistical series for grounding agents.
resources.status_reason: 2026 API changes — HTTP endpoint sunset (HTTPS-only) and per-minute call limits (~1,000/min), announced 2026-02-05 and revised 2026-07-09.
resources.status_reason_ko: 2026년 API 변경 — HTTP 엔드포인트 종료(HTTPS 전용) 및 분당 호출 제한(~1,000회/분), 2026-02-05 공지·2026-07-09 개정.

resources.name: KRX Market Data (Data Marketplace / OPEN API)
resources.description: Official Korea Exchange market data — daily OHLCV for KOSPI/KOSDAQ, ETF/ETN/ELW, bonds, and derivatives (2010–). Free of charge but account-gated: full access and the OPEN API (openapi.krx.co.kr) require a KRX account, terms agreement, and an approved auth key (issued ~1 day, valid 1 year).
resources.description_ko: 한국거래소 공식 시장 데이터 — KOSPI/KOSDAQ, ETF/ETN/ELW, 채권·파생 일별 OHLCV(2010~). 무료지만 계정 필요: 전체 접근과 OPEN API(openapi.krx.co.kr)는 KRX 계정·약관 동의·승인된 인증키(약 1일 내 발급, 1년 유효) 필요.
resources.korea_relevance: Authoritative KR equity/derivatives market data for cross-asset (KOSPI↔BTC) context.
resources.ai_utility: Structured market data, but registration-gated and non-commercial-only (may not resell or charge third parties for results).

resources.name: Alpha MCP (land.moss/alpha-mcp)
resources.description: Remote MCP server exposing ~12 tools over alpha.moss.land — search Korean YouTube channel stance, daily AI briefs, a canonical entity/topic/event store, a KR macro snapshot (BOK ECOS + FRED), and the disclosed AI-persona directory. Streamable-HTTP, no auth.
resources.description_ko: alpha.moss.land 위에 약 12개 도구를 노출하는 원격 MCP 서버 — 한국 유튜브 채널 스탠스 검색, AI 브리핑, 엔티티/토픽/이벤트 저장소, KR 매크로 스냅샷(BOK ECOS + FRED), AI 페르소나 디렉터리. Streamable-HTTP, 인증 불필요.
resources.korea_relevance: Puts Korean-market narrative + macro data behind a standard MCP interface for Claude / Cursor / Cline / Continue / Zed.
resources.ai_utility: Listed in the official MCP registry under a DNS-verified namespace — note the registry is self-publishing, not an editorial endorsement.
resources.status_reason: Depends on the alpha.moss.land upstream, a degraded beta — some tools (e.g. list_topics, list_events) currently return empty results.
resources.status_reason_ko: 저하된 베타인 alpha.moss.land 업스트림에 의존 — 일부 도구(예: list_topics, list_events)가 현재 빈 결과를 반환.

resources.name: Block Media (블록미디어)
resources.description: Korean blockchain/crypto news outlet (self-styled 'No.1 blockchain news') covering digital-finance policy, industry, research, and markets.
resources.description_ko: 디지털 금융 정책·산업·리서치·시장을 다루는 한국 블록체인/암호화폐 뉴스 매체('No.1 블록체인 뉴스' 표방).
resources.korea_relevance: Korean-language crypto news source.
resources.ai_utility: Fresh KR narrative text for retrieval.

resources.name: Decenter (디센터)
resources.description: Korean crypto/blockchain news hub run by Seoul Economic Daily, with real-time price tickers and coverage of tokenization, stablecoins, and policy.
resources.description_ko: 서울경제가 운영하는 한국 암호화폐/블록체인 뉴스 허브. 실시간 시세와 토큰화·스테이블코인·정책 보도.
resources.korea_relevance: Korean-language crypto news source backed by a major business daily.
resources.ai_utility: Fresh KR narrative text for retrieval.

resources.name: The Token Post (토큰포스트)
resources.description: Korean blockchain/crypto news media ('Korea's No.1') with market data, an academy, and airdrop sections.
resources.description_ko: 시장 데이터·아카데미·에어드롭 섹션을 갖춘 한국 블록체인/암호화폐 뉴스 매체('대한민국 No.1').
resources.korea_relevance: Korean-language crypto news source.
resources.ai_utility: Fresh KR narrative text for retrieval.

resources.name: Kaia
resources.description: Public EVM-compatible L1 blockchain formed by the Klaytn (Kakao's Ground X) × Finschia merger. Kaia is the active successor to the archived klaytn/klaytn repository.
resources.description_ko: 클레이튼(카카오 Ground X) × 핀시아 합병으로 만들어진 퍼블릭 EVM 호환 L1 블록체인. 아카이브된 klaytn/klaytn 저장소의 현행 후속.
resources.korea_relevance: The major Korea-originated L1 (Kakao lineage); relevant for KR-focused on-chain agents.
resources.ai_utility: Standard EVM tooling; see the Kaia Agent Kit for agent integrations.

resources.name: Kaia Agent Kit
resources.description: TypeScript toolkit for building AI agents on Kaia — plugin-based on-chain queries (Kaiascan), DEX (DragonSwap) integration, and Web3 token transfers.
resources.description_ko: Kaia 위에서 AI 에이전트를 만드는 TypeScript 툴킷 — 플러그인 기반 온체인 조회(Kaiascan), DEX(DragonSwap) 연동, Web3 토큰 전송.
resources.korea_relevance: Agent tooling for the Korea-originated Kaia chain.
resources.ai_utility: On-chain query + token-transfer plugins for agents; transfer capability makes it R3 (needs a wallet key).
resources.status_reason: Last significant commit 2025-10 (last release v0.0.16, Apr 2025); README has incomplete/broken links. Token-transfer capable (R3) — needs a wallet key.
resources.status_reason_ko: 마지막 주요 커밋 2025-10(마지막 릴리스 v0.0.16, 2025-04); README에 미완성/깨진 링크 존재. 토큰 전송 가능(R3) — 지갑 키 필요.

resources.name: FSC Virtual-Asset Market Survey (가상자산사업자 실태조사)
resources.description: Semiannual official survey of Korea's licensed VASPs by the FSC/FIU — market cap, trading volume, KRW deposits, account counts, listings, and operating profit. The H2-2025 edition (all 27 licensed VASPs) was published 2026-03-25.
resources.description_ko: 금융위원회/FIU가 반기마다 발표하는 국내 신고 가상자산사업자 실태조사 — 시가총액·거래량·원화예치금·이용자 수·상장 종목·영업이익. 2025년 하반기판(신고사업자 27곳)은 2026-03-25 발표.
resources.korea_relevance: Authoritative KR crypto market-structure statistics.
resources.ai_utility: Reliable market-size grounding data; recurring biannual release.

resources.name: KoFIU Registered VASP Status (가상자산사업자 신고현황)
resources.description: Official list of registered virtual-asset service providers (VASPs) published by KoFIU as an XLSX on its VASP board (updated ~semiannually; latest 2026-06-30). The authoritative record of which Korean exchanges/custodians are legally registered.
resources.description_ko: 금융정보분석원(KoFIU)이 VASP 게시판에 XLSX로 공개하는 신고 가상자산사업자 목록(약 반기마다 갱신, 최신 2026-06-30). 어떤 한국 거래소·수탁사가 합법적으로 신고되었는지에 대한 공식 기록.
resources.korea_relevance: Ground-truth for which Korean crypto operators are licensed — essential for compliance-aware agents.
resources.ai_utility: Official grounding dataset; note the XLSX is reached via the board (no stable static download URL — needs a browser session, not a bare GET).

resources.name: SignalMap
resources.description: Multi-source narrative pipeline that collects and summarizes curated Korean YouTube commentary (plus news/macro), maps videos by perspective (same / different / observation), and emits a canonical store of channels, topics, and videos.
resources.description_ko: 큐레이션된 한국 유튜브 논평(뉴스·매크로 포함)을 수집·요약하고 관점별(같은 방향/다른 방향/관찰)로 매핑해 채널·토픽·영상의 정규 저장소로 내보내는 다중 소스 내러티브 파이프라인.
resources.korea_relevance: Curates and structures Korean YouTube crypto/macro commentary that English-language tools don't index.
resources.ai_utility: Emits canonical topics/videos that downstream products (e.g. Alpha) and agents consume.
resources.status_reason: Homepage reports 82 channels while the /about page prose says '30 YouTubers' (stale copy). Crypto is one of several tracked topics, not the sole focus.
resources.status_reason_ko: 홈페이지는 82개 채널로 표시하지만 /about 문구는 '유튜버 30명'이라고 함(오래된 문구). 암호화폐는 여러 추적 토픽 중 하나이며 유일한 초점이 아님.

resources.name: Bithumb AI Trade Kit
resources.description: Official toolkit for AI agents to use the Bithumb API — market data, account queries, orders, deposits, and withdrawals — shipped as an MCP server, a terminal CLI, and Skills for Claude / Cursor / VS Code / Windsurf.
resources.description_ko: 빗썸 API를 AI 에이전트가 사용하도록 만든 공식 툴킷 — 시세·계정 조회·주문·입출금. MCP 서버, 터미널 CLI, Claude/Cursor/VS Code/Windsurf용 Skills로 제공.
resources.korea_relevance: Direct agent access to a major Korean exchange.
resources.ai_utility: MCP / CLI / Skills — but R3 (orders + withdrawal). Require human confirmation and disable withdrawal where possible.

resources.name: Upbit Agent Skills
resources.description: Official Agent Skills for Upbit covering market data, balances, order placement, and deposits/withdrawals. Wires an AI agent directly to a live Upbit account.
resources.description_ko: 시세·잔고·주문·입출금을 아우르는 업비트 공식 Agent Skills. AI 에이전트를 실계정에 직접 연결한다.
resources.korea_relevance: Direct agent access to the dominant Korean exchange.
resources.ai_utility: Ready-made Skills — but grants trade AND withdrawal. Treat as R3: use keys with withdrawal disabled and human-in-the-loop confirmation.

resources.name: Upbit Strategy Toolkit
resources.description: Official toolkit to design and backtest Upbit trading strategies by chatting with an AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor). Backtest-only — no live-trading permissions required (beta, v0.8.1).
resources.description_ko: AI 에이전트(Claude Code, Codex, Cursor)와 대화하며 업비트 트레이딩 전략을 설계·백테스트하는 공식 툴킷. 백테스트 전용 — 실거래 권한 불필요(베타, v0.8.1).
resources.korea_relevance: Natural-language strategy design and backtesting over Upbit's KRW market history.
resources.ai_utility: Agent-native (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor); the backtest sandbox means no live-key risk.
